raw_segments.text: Perdita, I'll not put the dibble in earth to set one slip of them. No more than where
I painted I would wish this youth should say, Twerwell, and only therefore desire to breed
by me. Here's flowers for you. Hot lavender, mints, savory, marjoram, the marigold. That
goes to bed with th sun and with him rises weeping. These are flowers of middle summer,
and I think they are given to men of middle age. You're very welcome.
